Sign this computer in to the tunnel: it prints a code to approve in your browser, signed in to the tunnel. The first time, it asks whether the tunnel should pass only through EU datacenters, and saves the answer in config.yaml (tunnel.eu_only); change it there and sign in again to switch. "codeflower tunnel pair" signs in first when needed.

Signing in again replaces this computer's connector: paired browsers must pair again.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower tunnel login [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--name string` |  | this computer's name in your account (default: its host name) |
| `--no-browser` |  | print the approval page's address instead of opening a browser |
| `--url string` |  | the tunnel to use, saved in config.yaml (default https://tunnels.codeflower.app) |

## Inherited flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config string` |  | config directory with config.yaml (or set $CODEFLOWER_CONFIG; default ~/.codeflower) |
